newsitem.title: UK: Duchess of York pays off debts - tabloid.
newsitem.headline: Duchess of York pays off debts - tabloid.

text.p: Britain's Duchess of York, popularly known as Fergie, has cleared her 4.2 million pounds ($6.89 million) of debts, a newspaper reported.

But the duchess, who recently signed a string of promotional deals in the United States, told the Sun newspaper: "This does not mean I can sit back and relax. I've got to continue to work hard to pay my way."
The former Sarah Ferguson, whose 10-year marriage to Queen Elizabeth's second son Prince Andrew ended in divorce last year, has taken to the public spotlight in an effort to pay off her heavy debts.
She struck lucrative deals in the United States to advertise cranberry juice on television and to be spokeswoman for Weight Watchers International.
Austrian construction industry magnate Richard Lugner, 64, is reported to have paid 461,000 schillings ($40,000) for the pleasure of Fergie's company at Vienna's glitzy Opera Ball on Thursday night.
